title: 第19章 震惊到膛目结舌的金灵圣母第20章 孤要这洪荒尽归我大商
slug: 重生商纣开局怒怼圣人女娲
content_zh:
第19章震惊到膛目结舌的金灵圣母！“人皇，我在来的时候，听闻人皇大德，人道赐下至宝奖励人皇，不知人皇能不能让老身看看，何为人道至宝？”
酒过三巡、菜过五味后，金灵圣母半试探半好奇地说到。
她一是想看看，人皇是不是如传闻中那样无惧一切，二就是真想看看什么是‘人道至宝’！
她听说过混沌至宝、先天至宝、后天至宝，哪怕是地道至宝她也知道，后土娘娘手中的六道轮回，就是地道至宝。
还真的从没听说过人道至宝！
“呃……”
帝辛听后面露愕然，微微顿了一下，可他还没来得及开口，金灵圣母便面无表情地说道：“人皇莫怪，是老身唐突了！”
淦！
帝辛在心里暗骂一句。
要不是知道金灵圣母的脾气，就凭她这时候的态度，帝辛反手就要把她镇压了。
不过看在她是闻仲的师尊，还是通天教主最看重的弟子之一的份上，帝辛还是压下了心中的不快。
笑着说道：“圣母误会了，只是人道至宝除了孤下诏之外，任何人都碰不得，特别是有道之士，圣母贵为圣人门下，若是孤给圣母下诏，怕给圣母惹来非议！”
一旁的闻仲也赶紧起身行礼道：“是啊师尊，大王说得没错，人道至宝若是没有大王诏令，任何人都碰不得！”
“是老身唐突了，还望人皇不要见怪！”
听到闻仲的话，金灵圣母这才反应过来，再度对着帝辛颔首，一脸歉意地说到，
“圣母实在是见外了，虽然孤王不方便对圣母下诏，但是让太师拿给圣母端详，还是没问题的，闻太师听令……”
帝辛说着，就地下了诏令，之后让他拿着人皇剑让金灵圣母品鉴，而一旁的东海龙王也凑了过来，
当圣母和龙王探出神力接近人皇剑，感受到人皇剑中那股强大的人道之力后，顿时心生震惊。
金灵圣母还强点，只是勉强退了半步，而东海龙王则面色一变，一连退了三步才止住身形！
“师尊，这就是人道至宝人皇剑，非大王亲口下令，徒儿也拿不起此剑，还有另一件至宝人皇玺，现在正镇压着西方教的菩提道人，一会儿徒儿带师尊过去看看！”

闻仲说完后，就看到满脸震惊的金灵圣母，下意识地点了点头，可紧接着，金灵圣母突然扭头看向闻仲，
瞪着大眼，声音发颤道：“你你你……你刚刚说什么？镇压着谁？”
“西方教菩提道人！”
闻仲再说了一遍，同时满脸肯定地看向金灵圣母。
而金灵圣母瞳孔猛地一缩，再度震惊道：“菩提道人？你跟为师开什么玩笑，你可知那菩提道人可是……”
“西方教圣人准提的三尸之一，徒儿已经知道！”
闻仲咂舌，之后摇头道：“之前菩提道人求见大王，还对大王妄动杀机，于是被人道之力镇压在大王书房中，大王怕他施展神通跑掉，所以后用人皇玺将他镇压了！”
一旁的东海龙王也是目露震惊，
之前那一幕他虽然没在，可他的神识却在啊！
他亲眼看着帝辛拿着人皇玺，往菩提的头上一砸，差点把菩提脑袋砸扁，把他的脊梁骨压断。
金灵圣母听后却如遭雷击，下意识地喃喃自语道：“这……这菩提身为圣人三尸，他竟然在朝歌内对人皇动杀机，他是傻了吗？”
金灵圣母可没忘记，她来到朝歌城外时，看到朝歌上空那股强大的人道之力，是何等的恐怖。
别说圣人三尸，就算是圣人，恐怕都不敢随便入朝歌！
content_en:
Chapter 19 The Holy Mother of the Golden Spirit was shocked to the point of being speechless! "Human Emperor, when I came here, I heard that the Human Emperor was a great virtue and that humanity gave him a supreme treasure to reward him. I wonder if the Human Emperor could show me what the supreme treasure of humanity is?"
After three rounds of wine and five flavors of food, the Golden Spirit Mother said half tentatively and half curiously.
Firstly, she wanted to see if the Human Emperor was as fearless as the rumors said, and secondly, she really wanted to see what the 'humane treasure' was!
She had heard about the Chaos Treasure, the Innate Treasure, and the Acquired Treasure. Even if it was an authentic treasure, she knew that the Six Paths of Reincarnation in the hands of Empress Houtu was an authentic treasure.
I have never heard of the Supreme Treasure of Humanity!
"Uh..."
Di Xin was astonished when he heard the expression behind him, and paused slightly, but before he could speak, the Holy Mother of the Golden Spirit said expressionlessly: "Don't blame the Human Emperor, I'm just being rude!"
Gan!
Di Xin cursed secretly in his heart.
If he hadn't known the temper of the Holy Mother of the Golden Spirit, Di Xin would have suppressed her with his backhand just based on her attitude at this moment.
However, considering that she was Wen Zhong's master and one of the most valued disciples of Master Tongtian, Di Xin still suppressed the unhappiness in his heart.
She smiled and said, "Our Lady has misunderstood. It's just that no one can touch the most precious human treasure except for those who have issued an edict. Especially those who are righteous. Our Lady is the disciple of a saint. If I issue an edict to Our Lady alone, I'm afraid it will bring criticism to Our Lady!"
Wen Zhong, who was on the side, also quickly stood up and saluted: "Yes, Master, the king is right. Without the king's edict, no one can touch the most precious human treasure!"
"I'm being rude, I hope the Human Emperor won't take offense!"
After hearing Wen Zhong's words, Holy Mother Jin Ling reacted, nodded to Di Xin again, and said apologetically,
"The Holy Mother is really out of touch. Although it is inconvenient for the lonely king to issue an edict to the Holy Mother, there is still no problem in letting the Grand Master show it to the Holy Mother for inspection. I heard that the Grand Master obeyed the order..."
As Di Xin spoke, he issued an edict, and then asked him to hold the Human Emperor Sword for the Holy Mother of the Golden Spirit to taste. The Dragon King of the East China Sea also came over,
When the Holy Mother and the Dragon King used their divine power to approach the Human Emperor Sword and felt the powerful human power in the Human Emperor Sword, they were immediately shocked.
The Holy Mother of the Golden Spirit was stronger and barely took half a step back, while the Dragon King of the East China Sea's expression changed and he took three steps back before he stopped!
"Master, this is the most precious human treasure, the Human Emperor Sword. Unless the king personally orders it, my disciple cannot hold this sword. There is also another most precious treasure, the Human Emperor's Seal, which is currently suppressing the Bodhi Taoist priests of the Western religion. I will take the master over to have a look in a moment!"
After Wen Zhong finished speaking, he saw the shocked Mother Jin Ling and nodded subconsciously. But then, Mother Jin Ling suddenly turned to look at Wen Zhong,
With wide eyes and a trembling voice, he said: "You, you, you... what did you just say? Who are you suppressing?"
"Western Bodhisattva Taoist!"
Wen Zhong said it again, and at the same time looked at the Holy Mother of the Golden Spirit with an affirmative look on his face.
The pupils of the Holy Mother Jinling suddenly shrank, and she was shocked again and said: "Taoist Bodhi? Are you kidding me? Do you know that Taoist Bodhi is..."
"One of the three corpses mentioned by the Western sage, my disciple already knows!"
Wen Zhong smacked his tongue, then shook his head and said: "Taoist Bodhi asked to see the king before, and even attempted murder against the king, so he was suppressed by the power of humanity in the king's study. The king was afraid that he would use his magical powers to run away, so he used the human emperor's seal to suppress him!"
The Dragon King of East China Sea on the side also looked shocked.
Although he was not present in the previous scene, his consciousness was still there!
He watched with his own eyes as Di Xin took the Human Emperor's Seal and hit Bodhi on the head, almost flattening Bodhi's head and breaking his spine.
After hearing this, the Holy Mother of the Golden Spirit felt as if she had been struck by lightning, and murmured to herself subconsciously: "This... this Bodhi is the three corpses of a saint, and he actually murders the Human Emperor in Chaoge. Is he stupid?"
Our Lady of Jinling did not forget that when she came outside Chaoge City, she saw the wave of waves above Chaoge.How terrifying is the powerful power of humanity.
Not to mention the three corpses of the saint, even the saint would not dare to enter the court song casually!
